title.zh: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
title.en: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens

current_state.zh: The FCA published perimeter guidance on which crypto activities require authorization, two weeks before the UK application window opens on September 30 and ahead of the regime taking effect on October 25, 2027.
current_state.en: The FCA published perimeter guidance on which crypto activities require authorization, two weeks before the UK application window opens on September 30 and ahead of the regime taking effect on October 25, 2027.
